"""Run with the 1.0.0 code: writes a 1.0.0 setup (entry and stores) for the 1.1.0 migration tests."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from homeassistant.core import HomeAssistant
from pytest_homeassistant_custom_component.common import MockConfigEntry

from .conftest import AddDevice
from .helpers import settle
from .policy_support import (
    AWAY, ESCALATION, FALLBACK, QUIET, REMINDER, SUMMARIZE,
    add_audience, add_policy, make_household, move, send,
)

OUT = Path("/Users/philiphoolmans/Local_Repos/notifyme/tests/fixtures/setup_1_0_0.json")


@pytest.fixture
def options() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"policy_mode": "all"}


async def test_capture(
    hass: HomeAssistant,
    entry: MockConfigEntry,
    mobile_app_device: AddDevice,
    hass_storage: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    await make_household(hass, mobile_app_device)
    await add_audience(hass, entry, "Family", kind="persons", persons=["person.anna", "person.ben"])
    await add_policy(hass, entry, "Escalate", severities=["critical"], **ESCALATION)
    await add_policy(hass, entry, "Remind", severities=["warning"], **REMINDER)
    await add_policy(hass, entry, "Night", severities=["info"], **QUIET)
    await add_policy(hass, entry, "Away", **AWAY)
    await add_policy(hass, entry, "Away short", severities=["warning"], max_wait=30, critical_passes=False, type="away")
    await add_policy(hass, entry, "Backup", severities=["critical"], **FALLBACK)
    await add_policy(hass, entry, "Digest", tags=["digest"], **SUMMARIZE)
    move(hass, "person.ben", "not_home")
    await send(hass, entry, id="held", severity="warning", to={"push": {"audience": "Family"}})
    await settle(hass, entry)
    assert await hass.config_entries.async_unload(entry.entry_id)
    await hass.async_block_till_done()
    stores = {k: v for k, v in hass_storage.items() if k.startswith("heads_up")}
    held = [r for r in stores["heads_up.deliveries"]["data"]["deliveries"] if r.get("hold") == "away"]
    assert held, "an Away hold must be in the capture"
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps({
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "entry": {
            "version": entry.version, "minor_version": entry.minor_version,
            "data": dict(entry.data), "options": dict(entry.options),
            "subentries": [
                {"subentry_id": s.subentry_id, "subentry_type": s.subentry_type, "title": s.title,
                 "unique_id": s.unique_id, "data": dict(s.data)}
                for s in entry.subentries.values()
            ],
        },
        "stores": stores,
    }, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) + "\n")
